licenses.author_processing_code: GPL-3.0, external inspected artifact, not imported or vendored
licenses.evidence_excerpts: Inherited article-specific licenses; raw research sidecar remains private

limitations: Labels apply only to the unchanged five-field structured claim against the released evidence passage.
The current full paragraph, extra clinical qualifiers and entire graph assertion remain unassessed.
Unmatched records and parallel source records remain in the denominator; no absent record is labelled false.
Added gold-labelled coverage is not a graph-wide accuracy gain or model-prediction improvement.
clinical.source_lineage: Shared CIViC knowledgebase and cited studies; separate published human claim-evidence review, not independent experiment.
clinical.version_and_exposure: 2024.05.21 manual review uses the older five-field claim format. March2025 model/references previously consumed; June2026 schema adds direction/origin/interaction. No new blind model evaluation.

interpretation: Published curator agreement, assay/reference concordance and independent new experiments are distinct.
Source exposure and human label independence are recorded separately; provider reuse is not new replication.
Known-label subsets are convenience reference overlaps, not a probability sample of all graph assertions.
No missing reference row, unknown location, unavailable source identity or absent score creates negative gold.
The inspected historical and current source/control outcomes are consumed development; no fresh-blind or population confirmation is claimed.

limitations: Positive-reference recovery is not biological precision or accuracy.
HPA/UniProt/OpenCell study/source reuse is possible; released positive sets may be incomplete.
Pinned author construction code permits OpenCell-only output; actual per-label dual-source provenance is unconfirmed.
Canonical accession matching does not establish historical sequence, proteoform or cell-state identity.
Fixed explicit GO crosswalk is incomplete; unmapped input terms are not false annotations.
Source-profile and ontology-scope changes have coverage effects; no isolated causal mechanism or population gain is identified.

localization_source_trace.interpretation: B gains are additional captured native GO terms under identical fixed mappings, not an effect achievable solely by filtering old Pharos rows. Annotation vintage and study independence are unresolved. C restriction and coarse dictionary effects are reported separately.

limits: Static2020 gene-level expert inventory; no isoform/cell-state universality.
GO/UniProt literature nominated some curator candidates; study reuse remains possible.
Fixed source/semantic profiles change annotations and coverage together, not an isolated pruning effect.
All zero/unlisted reference values stay unknown. A negative classifier output is a heuristic decision, not proof of biological absence.
Known-label descriptive cohort metrics do not estimate the precision of all graph assertions.
mitocarta.scope: Frozen original-primary gene-level inventory classification; no historical GO truth relabelling

clingen.limitation: Expert curations target specified monogenic disease and mode of inheritance. No exact source-disease overlap; gene-only or ancestor-disease joins cannot validate broad colorectal associations.
clingen.retrieval_note: urllib trust-store failure preserved; native curl verified TLS and downloaded full generic bulk.

drugcentral.limitation: Same potential upstream target-drug curation lineage; exact names are not a chemical structure crosswalk; listing does not assert potency, mechanism, clinical indication or response.
drugcentral.version_note: Official download link uses /2027/; observed download page lists dump date 2026-09-25. No unverified version equivalence is assumed.
